meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可操作浏览器完成打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取数据等任务，并在任务需要时自动使用浏览器。
howto.when: 当浏览器对任务有帮助时自动触发，如查资料、操作网页或提取数据；即使没明说也会用。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com，然后截图
say.note: Claude 会打开网址并截取页面。

say.text: 搜索'人工智能最新进展'并整理要点
say.note: Claude 会用浏览器搜索并提取信息。

say.text: 填写这个登录表单并提交
say.note: Claude 会填充文本框并点击提交。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can control a real browser to complete tasks such as opening pages, clicking elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, and extracting data. It will automatically start the browser when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a browser would be useful, such as researching topics, interacting with web apps, or extracting page data, even if the user doesn't explicitly ask for a browser.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will open the URL and capture the page.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI developments and summarize them
say_en.note: Claude will browse and extract key points.

say_en.text: Fill in this login form and submit it
say_en.note: Claude will fill in the fields and click submit.
